highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 will correct texture sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
highlights_body: The upcoming servicing update also aligns image-filter cache-key equality with hashing, without changing the public managed or C API.

bullets.lead: Keep filtered images within texture subsets
bullets.detail: Corrects sampling constraints for antialiased and multisampled Ganesh draws under minification or strong skew. Logical texture bounds and stricter subset clamping prevent unrelated backing-texture pixels from contaminating filtered images.
Makes image-filter cache-key equality match its bytewise hash, distinguishing signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata for consistent lookup and eviction.

Handles font-scaler reloads that change glyph paths, formats, or bounds. Uses the reloaded outline, rejects incompatible overlap copies, and preserves full plane strides for clipped emboss masks, avoiding stale rendering, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted mask planes.
